content_of_post_to_comment:
This isn't the 1940s or the 2000s anymore. Wake up. We are going to play Tung Tung Sahur memes or listen to phonk, and that's normal. And the problems on social media are already going up in flames, but there are still some idiots acting elite while Ukraine and Russia are waging a war, and the internet is becoming more and more boring, especially with politics, outrage, toxic people, and trolls. Elitism is something easy to ignore, because writing a long article to prove how prestigious your own work is cannot stop the trash content on the internet from being produced.

I'm also tired of arguing about every kind of war on the internet, and elitism looks like a status that nobody actually cares about. Even though Charlie Chaplin was very talented, that doesn't mean he could take down Hitler. Elitists should at least understand that many people on the internet just want to listen to good music or watch their neighbor's videos. And actually, those elitists could really be 12-year-old kids. Who the fuck cares? Go touch grass.
